title: 전직대통령 예우에 관한 법률 / queue:ADDENDUM:07796:20051229:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (State Public Officials Act) <Act No. 7796, December 29, 2005>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

Articles 2 through 5
Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (52) Omitted.

(53) The Honorable Treatment of Ex-Presidents Act shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 6 (2), "one shall be a public official in special service of the State equivalent to Grade I and two shall be public officials in special service of the State equivalent to Grade II" shall be replaced with "public officials in special service belonging to the Senior Executive Service".

(54) through (68) Omitted.
